text_blocks.snippet: M54.12 is the ICD-10-CM code for radiculopathy, cervical region. This code indicates that a patient is experiencing nerve pain caused by the compression or irritation of a nerve root in the neck area. Common symptoms include pain radiating from the neck down the arm, numbness, tingling, and weakness in the arm or hand.
